scripts.label: Explanation cue discovered attack
scripts.text: Check what lines open when a blocking piece moves.

scripts.label: Explanation cue double attack
scripts.text: Look for a move that creates two threats at once, including checks and opened lines.

scripts.label: Explanation cue back rank
scripts.text: Check your king's escape squares before moving a back-rank defender.

scripts.label: Explanation cue promotion awareness
scripts.text: Count the moves to promotion and check forcing pawn advances.

scripts.label: Explanation cue abandoned defender
scripts.text: Before moving a defender, check which pieces will lose its protection.

scripts.label: Explanation cue avoiding bad trades
scripts.text: Count what you capture and what their recapture takes from you.

scripts.label: Explanation cue deflection
scripts.text: Check whether a forcing exchange pulls a defender away from another target.

scripts.label: Explanation note curated authority
scripts.text: The saved answers define this exercise. A different legal move is not necessarily bad chess.

scripts.label: Explanation note strong replies
scripts.text: This is one engine continuation against strong replies. It does not mean every reply is forced.

scripts.label: Explanation note material scope
scripts.text: Material changes describe only the shown line, compared with its starting position. The written explanation gives the piece values used.

scripts.label: Explanation note no simple reason
scripts.text: The saved line does not establish a simple tactical reason. Step through it to compare the replies; no positional explanation has been inferred.

scripts.label: Explanation note saved policy
scripts.text: This explanation uses the answer policy saved for this exercise. Its setting is shown in the written notes.

scripts.label: Opening recall revealed
scripts.text: Here is your studied continuation.

scripts.label: Opening recall accepted
scripts.text: This matches your selected study material.

scripts.label: Opening recall retry fallback
scripts.text: Play a move from the study lines you selected.

scripts.label: Opening recall cold multiple
scripts.text: Any continuation from these selected lines is accepted.

scripts.label: Opening recall cold single
scripts.text: Recall a move from your selected study material.

scripts.label: Opening recall rejected
scripts.text: This move is outside the opening moves you selected to study. Try again.

scripts.label: Opening recall rejected changed
scripts.text: That move is outside your selected opening lines. Try again; this saved attempt does not update the changed study's review schedule.

scripts.label: Opening recall rejected retired
scripts.text: That move is outside your selected opening lines. Try again; this retired position's review schedule stays unchanged.
